CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW agent.messages AS
WITH line AS (
    SELECT transcript AS file_path, message AS msg FROM agent.lines
), block AS (
    SELECT * EXCLUDE (msg), unnest(CASE json_type(msg -> 'content') WHEN 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract(msg, '$.content[*]') ELSE [msg -> 'content'] END) AS b
    FROM line WHERE msg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT file_path, b ->> 'type' AS block_type FROM block
